## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-4005 by identifying that the 502 Bad Gateway errors are caused by **storefront-web 3.0.0 failing to connect to the OpenTelemetry collector**. The pod logs revealed repeated connection refusals to `otel-collector.observability.svc:4317` and export queue overflow errors. While the Kubernetes pods report as "Running and Ready" (because health checks pass), the application is becoming unstable due to the OpenTelemetry collection failures.

The recommended fix is to investigate the OTel collector availability and connectivity rather than rolling back, allowing the team to keep the pricing fix in version 3.0.
